summary: DNS of the cubic cavity at Re = 1950 until the limit cycle has saturated, and the period of the cycle from the probe signal.
description: DNS of the cubic cavity at Re = 1950 from the steady flow of Re = 1914 until the limit cycle has saturated (t = 1800). plot.py measures the period of the probe signal at the cavity centre over t = 1400 to the end of the run, by a harmonic fit, by the FFT peak and by the zero-crossing count. The Floquet stages integrate over the fitted period. The reference holds the three estimates, the rms residual of the fit, and the mean and half-range of the probe signal. The values are those of the run named under produced.

period_fit.note: Least-squares fit of a mean and three harmonics with a free frequency, window t = 1400 to the end of the run. The Floquet stages use this value.

period_fft.note: Peak of the FFT of the same window, refined by a parabola. Its resolution depends on the length of the window.

period_crossings.note: Mean time between upward zero crossings of the same window. From t = 1000 the count gives 10.798, because the window still holds the end of the saturation.

fit_rms.note: Rms residual of the fit, in units of the lid speed. A window from t = 1200 gives 3.0e-06, from t = 1000 gives 9.2e-05.

probe_mean.note: Mean term of the fit: time average of vy at the cavity centre, in units of the lid speed.

probe_half_range.note: Half of the difference between the largest and the smallest vy at the cavity centre in the window, in units of the lid speed.
